name: Lee Step Stool
subtitle: Sycamore, cherry & a little blue
description: A rounded sycamore stool with four flush through cherry legs and removable blue LEE letters in a clean rounded sans-serif style. Letter height, width, horizontal gaps, wood border and fit are independently editable. Defaults use a 13 × 9 × 1½-inch top, 6¼-inch leg clearance and 1¼-inch legs.

parameters.label: Top length
parameters.description: Overall length of the top. Letter layout stays centered as the top changes.

parameters.label: Top width
parameters.description: Overall front-to-back width of the top.

parameters.label: Top thickness
parameters.description: Thickness of the top. Pocket depth is limited to leave wood beneath the letters.

parameters.label: Leg clearance
parameters.description: Distance from the floor to the underside of the top. Overall stool height also includes the top thickness.

parameters.label: Leg diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of each cylindrical leg. Socket diameter also includes the clearance on both sides.

parameters.label: Leg center setback
parameters.description: Distance from each top edge to the center of a leg. The minimum adjusts to keep each socket inside the rounded top.

parameters.label: Top corner radius
parameters.description: Radius of the top corners when viewed from above.

parameters.label: Edge roundover
parameters.description: Radius of the rounded upper and lower edges of the top.

parameters.label: Letter height
parameters.description: Height of all three letters, independent of their width. The layout adjusts to preserve the wood border and avoid the sockets.

parameters.label: Minimum wood border
parameters.description: Minimum wood border between the letter pockets and the top edges, including the finger wells.

parameters.label: Letter width
parameters.description: Width of each letter, independent of height. Horizontal gaps are measured between the letter edges.

parameters.label: Horizontal letter gap
parameters.description: Horizontal distance between adjacent letter edges. Larger fit clearances require a little extra space between the pockets.

parameters.label: Letter and pocket depth
parameters.description: Thickness of each removable letter and the depth of its blind pocket. Letters sit flush with the top.

parameters.label: Letter top roundover
parameters.description: Rounds the upper edge of each removable letter inward. Start with 1/16 inch. The straight-wall letter size and fit clearance stay unchanged; small strokes limit the radius.

parameters.label: Pocket rim roundover
parameters.description: Rounds the top edge facing each letter across the gap, including the finger well. Start with 1/16 inch. The mouth opens above the straight-wall fit; tight E notches and nearby sockets limit the radius.

parameters.label: Letter clearance per side
parameters.description: Gap between a letter and its pocket on each side. Larger values make removal easier. The pocket grows by twice this value across its width and height; the letter size stays the same. Workshop starting point: 0.8–1.2 mm per side after finishing; try 1.2–1.5 mm for easier lifting. Test a finished scrap sample; wood movement can tighten the fit.

parameters.label: Leg socket clearance per side
parameters.description: Radial gap between a leg and its socket. Socket diameter equals leg diameter plus twice this value. Larger values give a looser fit; the leg diameter stays the same.

parameters.label: Finger well radius
parameters.description: Radius of the semicircular lifting well. The circular part is twice the radius across; tangent entry curves widen the mouth. Try 3/8–1/2 inch for children and 1/2–5/8 inch for adults, then test the actual thumbs. Narrow letters limit the radius. For a measured thumb pad, start with a circular diameter 2–4 mm wider than the pad.

dimensionTargets: User-selected defaults: top 13 × 9 × 1.5 inches, 1.25-inch leg diameter and 6.25-inch floor-to-underside clearance.
0.75-inch-deep letters with a positive blind pocket floor. Letter clearance supports 0.125 inch per side; leg socket clearance supports 0.0625 inch per side.
Independent 3.25-inch letter height, 2-inch letter width, 1-inch horizontal gaps and a 1.5-inch minimum wood border.
Positive blind pocket floors, at least 1.27 mm between adjacent pocket bounds and 3.175 mm between pocket bounds and sockets.
invariants: Keep three independent removable LEE inserts and four flush through legs.
Keep pocket floors, fit gaps, sockets and rounded top in the same shared parametric geometry.
Keep letter pockets separated from sockets and each other.
Preserve eight closed solids in assembled and individual part exports.
Keep leg sockets inside the rounded top and normalize letter size and spacing to preserve the wood border.
Keep independent letter-top and pocket-rim roundovers above the straight-wall fit, with simple face/mouth contours and positive pocket/socket webs.
